swap.label: Weak ring on the left hand, good ring on the right, better ring in pack
swap.explanation: Original: the left-slot search skips Free Action (it was the last ring tried on the right), so the only plan containing it puts it on the right hand; the Borg takes off See Invisible and wears Free Action, keeping Feather Falling. Corrected: Free Action is also tried on the left; the Borg takes off Feather Falling and wears Free Action, keeping See Invisible.
